svg.title: 16 ideal binary phase regions
svg.desc: Equilibrium phase regions inferred from the existing ideal-binary liquidus model with invented melting temperatures and fusion enthalpies. Above the liquidus the material is liquid; between the liquidus and eutectic temperature it is liquid plus the indicated pure solid; below the eutectic it is A and B solids. The region labels follow the model assumptions and are not predictions for Pluto's real volatile mixtures.
